title: Tab colour push, slower motion with a soft bounce, fuller ambient colour
changes: Switching tabs now pushes colour: the new tab's colour enters from the side of the chosen tab and pushes the previous tab's colour out the opposite way
Motion is slower (1.5s colour push, 0.9s panels) and finishes with a small overshoot bounce
Ambient colour is fuller: stronger and wider edge glows, a lightly tinted centre, and a less darkened tab colour
Ambient layers use the exact tab colour from the first frame (no colour fade) and are oversized so the bounce never exposes a gap; the drift animation keeps running across switches
Panels slide in from the same side as the colour push
